title: Pasta con Sarde

ingredients.name: dash red pepper flakes or hot sauce

steps.text: Warm up a skillet large enough to hold the pasta. Toast pine nuts, then remove.
Thinly slice onion and fennel (reserving the fronds) and garlic.
Heat olive oil, add onion and fennel and cook around 5 minutes; add garlic, salt, and pepper. Continue cooking until nearly soft, then garlic for 1 minute.
Add wine, after a minute add anchovies and sardines, breaking them up with a wooden spatula.
Cook pasta until al dente. Roughly chop fennel fronds.
To skillet, add currants, pine nuts, fennel seeds and pepper flakes. Continue over very low heat.
Add some pasta water to skillet until there's a bit of a sauce. Add pasta, mix, add fennel fronds.

notes: Currants shouldn't be omitted and are better than raisins, they're not as pronounced nor as sweet. Can replace anchovies with anchovy paste – if so, add when cooking up onions and fennel. White wine could be replaced with chicken stock or white vermouth
